infoLinks.urlText: Dee Why bus diversions for Anzac Day
infoLinks.content:

Buses traveling away from Manly will divert via Oakes Avenue and Clyde Road to return to route on Howard Avenue. Stop Howard Ave after The Strand (209944) will be missed.  
Services travelling towards Manly will run as normal.  
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction. Some trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 15 and Thursday 16 April
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction, but do not stop at Martin Place.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between South Coast Line stations and Central, platforms 1-14.
  • Change at Central for buses to Kings Cross, Edgecliff and Bondi Junction or metro services to Martin Place.

  • Nightly from 10.40pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make extra stops at Arncliffe and Sydenham.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
20T4 Bondi Junction, Edgecliff, Kings Cross, Central and return (bypassing Martin Place)
23T4 Bondi Junction, Town Hall and return
36T4 Arncliffe, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return
324/325 City, Walsh Bay to Watsons Bay via Town Hall (Park St), Kings Cross, Edgecliff stations and return
333 City to Bondi Beach via Martin Place and Bondi Junction stations and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

Buses travelling to the city from Chiswick will divert away from Park Street via Clarence Street, Market Street and York Street to end trips at QVB, York St Stand D (200044).   
Buses leaving the city will start trips from QVB, York St Stand B (200042) and return to route on Druitt Street.  
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time. Visit the Anzac Day Dawn Service & March – Sydney CBD event page for more transport details. 
 
Missed stops:

  • Hyde Park, Park St, Stand B (2000157) 
  • William St opp Australian Museum (201154) 
  • St Mary's Cathedral, St Marys Rd (2000410)

infoLinks.urlText: L1 Dulwich Hill, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines weekend closures due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
On Saturday 18 to Sunday 19 April, L1 Dulwich Hill, L2 Randwick and L3 Kingsford Lines will be impacted by closures due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.
 
During this time:
 
L1 Dulwich Hill line
  • L1 light rail services will not run.
  • Use alternative transport including L1 replacement bus services, regular bus services or walking if able to, between Central Grand Concourse and Dulwich Hill.
L2 and L3 light rail services
  • L2 and L3 services will not run between Circular Quay and Central Chalmers Street.
  • Use alternative transport including trains, regular bus services or walking if able to, between Circular Quay and Central.
  • L2 and L3 light rail services will continue running between Central and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford as per normal schedule.
L1 replacement bus services:
Replacement bus services will run from 5am to 1am daily as follows:
  • From 5am to 9pm: every 10 to 15 min,
  • From 9pm to 1am: every 15 to 20 min.
These times may vary depending on road traffic.
 
Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
  • Capitol Square (in both directions): please use the alternative stop at Paddy’s Market (approx. 5 minute walk) for buses towards Dulwich Hill/The Star, or walk to Central Station (approx. 7 minute walk),
  • Exhibition Centre (towards Dulwich Hill / The Star) - Please use the alternative stop at Convention (approx. 7 minute walk),
Please note: due to road closures around Darling Dr, some bus routes have been diverted and may take longer. Allow extra travel time.
 
Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.
 
Where the replacement bus has an opal reader on board, you must tap on and tap off. A standard light rail fare applies.
 
L1 Dulwich Hill Line light rail services will continue to run as per normal schedule.
 
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.
 
L1, L2 and L3 light rail services will resume as normal from 5am Monday 20 April.

infoLinks.urlText: Coogee bus diversions on Anzac Day
infoLinks.content:
From 5am until 7.30am on Saturday 25 April, route 313 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for an Anzac Day Dawn Service. 
Buses travelling to Coogee will end trips at Havelock Ave at Asher St (203467).  
Buses leaving Coogee will start trips at Havelock Ave at Asher St (203467) and divert via Arden Street and Carr Street to return to normal route.  
Stops on Arden St will be missed in both directions.  
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.  

Missed stops: 
  • Arden St at Carr St (203468) 
  • Arden St at Coogee Bay Rd (203469) 
  • Arden St at Dolphin St (203470) 
  • Arden St opp Coogee Bay Rd (203471) 
  • Arden St at Carr St (203473) 
  • Havelock Ave at Asher St (203474)

infoLinks.content:

Buses travelling to Coogee will divert via Byron Street, Carr Street and Havelock Avenue to end trips at Havelock Ave at Asher St (203467).

infoLinks.urlText: Major Event Buses operating for the Sydney Royal Easter Show
infoLinks.content:
Sydney Olympic Park Major Event Buses will run on all nine routes each day during the Sydney Royal Easter Show from Thursday 2 to Monday 13 April 2026.  
  
Travel on the Major Event Buses is included in the cost of tickets to the Easter Show. No need to tap on and off, simply show your Easter Show ticket to the driver when boarding buses.   
  
Buses run every 10 to 20 minutes from early morning until around 2.30pm each day during the Show. 
  
Please note that timetables vary on weekdays and weekends and are subject to traffic conditions.  
  
Return buses will start leaving Olympic Park from 2pm each day, with the last bus leaving at 10.30pm each night. Additional buses will operate on Friday 3 April for fans attending the NRL game at Accor Stadium and on Thursday 9 April (Seniors Day), return buses start leaving Olympic Park from 1pm. 
  
For more information on transport options to the event including detailed bus timetables, see the Royal Easter Show event page.

infoLinks.urlText: Opal can be used between Wollongong and Moss Vale, Exeter and Bundanoon stations.
infoLinks.content:
If travelling by Coach between Wollongong station and Moss Vale, Exeter or Bundanoon stations you can use your Opal card or contactless card or device to tap on or off at your origin/destination station provided the origin/destination is an Opal enabled station.

If travelling onto Goulburn, or other Opal enabled station along the Southern Highlands Line, you should not tap off when transferring from Coach to an Intercity train but instead tap off at your destination station.

Booking is not required for Opal customers on this route.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD bus diversions on Anzac Day
infoLinks.content:
From 6am until 3pm on Saturday 25 April, route 389 services will be split into two routes due to road closures in place for the annual Anzac Day March.   
  • Eastern route between Bondi Junction and the city: buses travelling to the city from Bondi Junction will divert via William Street, Riley Street and St Mary’s Road to end trips at St Mary's Cathedral, St Marys Rd (2000410). Buses leaving the city will start trips from St Mary's Cathedral, College St (2000287) and divert via College Street to return to normal route on William Street. 
  • Western route between Pyrmont and the city: buses travelling to the city from Pyrmont will end trips at QVB York St, Stand D (200044). Buses leaving the city will start trips from QVB York St, Stand B (200042).  
Stops will be missed on Park Street and William Street. Continue on foot to between College Street and QVB to connect between the two routes.  
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time. Visit the Anzac Day Dawn Service & March – Sydney CBD event page for more transport details.  
 
Missed stops: 
  • Australian Museum, William St (201084) 
  • Hyde Park, Park St, Stand C (2000412) 
  • Town Hall, Park St, Stand J (2000425) 
  • Hyde Park, Park St, Stand B (2000157) 
  • Town Hall, Park St, Stand H (2000249)

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Richmond and Granville
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 18 and Sunday 19 April
  • Buses replace trains between Richmond and Granville.
  • T2 trains run to the normal timetable between Leppington and the City.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
35T1 Richmond, all stations to Blacktown, Parramatta, Granville and return
61T1 Tallawong, Schofields, then all stations to Granville and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Macquarie Fields
infoLinks.content:
Station Access Changes
From Tuesday 26 August 2025 until mid-2026, the pedestrian ramp access from Railway Parade into the station on Platform 2 will be closed for upgrade works.
During this time, station access will be available via the stairs only.
Planned Trackwork buses depart from Atchinson Rd near the Service Station.
If you require ramp or lift access, please visit transportnsw.info for your accessible travel options.
For more information about the project, please contact the Project Infoline on 1800 684 490 or visit www.transport.nsw.gov.au/macquariefields.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Sutherland and Hurstville
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 8 and Thursday 9 April     
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 2.30am, buses replace trains between Sutherland and Hurstville.
  • Trains run between Cronulla, Waterfall and Sutherland, and between Hurstville and Bondi Junction, to a changed timetable.

  • Wednesday from 9.50pm, metro services do not run between Sydenham and Central. Change at Martin Place for metro services towards Tallawong.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
43T4 Sutherland, all stations to Hurstville and return
45T4 Sutherland, express to Hurstville and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Parramatta Rd - Burwood, permanent bus stop closures
infoLinks.content:
Sydney Metro West construction work at Burwood will permanently close the following bus stops:
 
From 4am Monday, 4 April 2022
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 461X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd at Esher Lane (213431).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 416X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd before Parramatta Rd (213462).

From 6am Monday 4 April 2022:
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.

infoLinks.urlText: North Bondi bus diversions on Anzac Day
infoLinks.content:
From midnight until 7am on Saturday 25 April, route 380 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for an Anzac Day Dawn Service. 
Buses travelling to Watsons Bay will divert via Wairoa Avenue, Blair Street and Military Road to loop into North Bondi Shops and return to normal route.  
Buses travelling to Bondi Junction will loop into North Bondi Shops, Campbell Pde, Stand C (202626) and divert via Blair Street and Wairoa Avenue to return to normal route on Campbell Parade.  
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.  

Missed stops: 
  • Campbell Pde opp North Bondi Beach (202625) 
  • North Bondi Beach, Campbell Pde (202635) 
  • Campbell Pde opp Bondi Beach Public School (202637)

infoLinks.urlText: Route 850 is changing from 31 August
infoLinks.content:
• From Sunday 31 August, Route 850 services will no longer operate via Gregory Hills Drive to Gregory Hills Town Centre, instead it will operate via Camden Valley Way providing customers with a more efficient trip.
  • Alternative bus routes operating via Gregory Hills Drive and Town Centre include:
    • For travel to Minto, passengers can travel to Campbelltown Station via Route 840 and change to the T8 South and Airport Line.
    • For travel between Oran Park and Gregory Hills, passengers can use bus route 840.
    • For travel to Narellan passengers can use bus route 841. Timetable changes will also affect this route.
  • Plan your trip for real-time up to date information.

infoLinks.urlText: Parramatta bus diversions for A-League match
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 11 April
  • Road closures will be in place on sections of O’Connell St, Ross St and Victoria Rd for the A-League: Western Sydney Wanderers v Sydney FC game at CommBank Stadium.
  • Between approximately 9.30pm to 10pm, the following bus stops will be closed and routes 546, 549, 550, 600, 601 and 606 will divert while the road closures are in place.
  • Check signs at stops, walk to nearby alternative stops and see the road closure and transport map and event page for more details.
Closed and alternative stops:
  • Parramatta Leagues Club, O'Connell Street will be closed
    – alternative stop O’Connell Street opp Harold Street (for services towards the Hills and North West)
  • Our Lady of Mercy College, O'Connell Street will be closed
    – alternative stop O’Connell Street at Fennell Street (for services towards Parramatta Station)
  • Victoria Rd opp Prince Alfred Square will be closed
    – alternative stop Victoria Rd opp All Saints Anglican Church (for services towards Parramatta Station)
  • Prince Alfred Square, Victoria Rd will be closed
    – alternative stop All Saints' Anglican Church, Victoria Rd (for services towards the Hills, Epping and Macquarie Park)

infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 15 and Thursday 16 April
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction, but do not stop at Martin Place.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD bus diversions on Anzac Day
infoLinks.content:
From 6am until 3pm on Saturday 25 April, route 311 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for the annual Anzac Day March.  
Buses travelling to the City/Millers Point will divert via College Street, Macquarie Street, Bridge Street, Grosvenor Street, Lang Street, York Street, Erskine Street and Sussex Street to return to normal route.  
Buses leaving Millers Point will divert via Druitt Street, Sussex Street, Goulburn Street, Wentworth Avenue and College Street to return to route on William Street. At QVB, services will pick up from Stand B (200042) instead of Stand A.  
Buses on Oxford Street travelling towards Central will also divert via Crown Street, Foveaux Street, Elizabeth Street and Hay Street to return to normal route.  
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time. Visit the Anzac Day Dawn Service & March – Sydney CBD event page for more transport details.

urlText: Trains run between South Coast Line stations and Hurstville only
content:
Saturday 18 and Sunday 19 April
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between South Coast Line stations and Hurstville only.
  •  T4 Illawarra Line trains run to a changed timetable between Hurstville and the City Circle.
  • Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction, but do not stop at Martin Place.
  • Change at:
    - Hurstville for T4 trains towards the City
    - Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff
    - Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction.

  • From Martin Place Station, buses leave from nearby bus stops, or you can walk to Wynyard Station for trains to T4 Illawarra Line stations.

  • Metro trackwork may affect how you travel. Metro services do not run between Sydenham and Chatswood.
  • Use train services to continue your journey.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
20T4 Bondi Junction, Edgecliff, Kings Cross, Central and return (bypassing Martin Place)
23T4 Bondi Junction, Town Hall and return
324/325 City, Walsh Bay to Watsons Bay via Town Hall (Park St), Kings Cross, Edgecliff stations and return
333 City to Bondi Beach via Martin Place and Bondi Junction stations and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
subtitle: Trains run between South Coast Line stations and Hurstville only

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD bus diversions on Anzac Day
infoLinks.content:
From 6am until 3pm on Saturday 25 April, route 304 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for the annual Anzac Day March.  
Buses travelling to Circular Quay will divert via Hunt Street, Wentworth Avenue, College Street and Macquarie St to end trip at The Royal Botanic Gardens, Macquarie St (2000226). 
Buses leaving Circular Quay will divert via Bridge Street, Macquarie Street, Prince Albert Road, College Street, Wentworth Avenue and Commonwealth Street to return to route on Hunt Street.  
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time. Visit the Anzac Day Dawn Service & March – Sydney CBD event page for more transport details. 

Missed stops: 
  • Campbell St at Foster St (201025) 
  • Museum Station, Downing Centre, Stand E (200049) 
  • Museum Station, Elizabeth St, Stand D (200055) 
  • St James Station, Elizabeth St, Stand C (200057) 
  • Martin Place Station, Elizabeth St, Stand C (200042) 
  • Museum of Sydney, Phillip St (200059) 
  • Phillip St opp Museum of Sydney (200068) 
  • Martin Place Station, Elizabeth St, Stand E (2000283) 
  • Hyde Park, Elizabeth St, Stand A (2000167) 
  • Museum Station, Downing Centre, Stand A (200074) 
Alternative stops: 
  • Martin Place Station, Macquarie St, Stand A (200089) 
  • The Royal Botanic Gardens, Macquarie St (2000226) 
  • The Royal Botanic Gardens, Macquarie St (200093) 
  • Sydney Hospital, Macquarie St (2000198) 
  • St Mary's Cathedral, College St (2000287)

infoLinks.urlText: Olympic Park diversions during the Sydney Royal Easter Show
infoLinks.content:
From 4am Thursday 2 April to 4am Tuesday 14 April buses in Olympic Park will be using different stops and routes while roads are closed in the precinct for the Sydney Royal Easter Show.  
 
Stops on Park Street at Olympic Park Station and on Dawn Fraser Avenue will be closed. 
 
Routes 525 and 526 in both directions will use alternative stops on Edwin Flack Avenue and a temporary stop on Dawn Fraser Avenue at Park Street near the train station (212799). 
 
Routes 533 and N81 in both directions will use a a temporary stop on Dawn Fraser Avenue at Park Street near the train station (212799). 
  
Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternate stop locations. For more information on transport to the event and service changes, see the Sydney Royal Easter Show event page. 
 
Closed stops: 
  • Olympic Park Station, Park Street, Sydney Olympic Park (212712) - routes 526, 533, N81 
  • Park Street opposite Olympic Park Station, Sydney Olympic Park (212790) - routes 526, 533, N81 
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue opposite Olympic Park Station, Sydney Olympic Park (212791) - routes 525 and 526 
  • Olympic Park Station, Dawn Fraser Avenue, Sydney Olympic Park (212792) - routes 525 and 526 
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue after Edwin Flack Avenue, Sydney Olympic Park (212787) - routes 525 and 526 
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue before Edwin Flack Avenue, Sydney Olympic Park (212788) - routes 525 and 526

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD bus diversions on Anzac Day
infoLinks.content:
From 6am until 3pm on Saturday 25 April, route 324 & 325 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for the annual Anzac Day March.  
Buses travelling to Walsh Bay will divert via College Street, Macquarie Street, Bridge Street, Grosvenor Street, Lang Street, York Street, Erskine Street and Sussex Street to return to normal route.  
Buses leaving Walsh Bay will divert via Druitt Street, Sussex Street, Goulburn Street, Wentworth Avenue and College Street to return to route on William Street. At QVB, services will pick up from Stand B (200042) instead of Stand A.  
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time. Visit the Anzac Day Dawn Service & March – Sydney CBD event page for more transport details.

  • Hyde Park, Park St, Stand C (2000412) 
  • Town Hall, Park St, Stand J (2000425) 
  • Kent St after Market St (2000420) 
  • Wynyard Station, Kent St, Stand V (2000419) 
  • QVB, York St, Stand A (200041)

infoLinks.urlText: Extra early-morning services and L2/L3 partial closures for Anzac Day
infoLinks.content:
Sydney light rail services will be impacted on Saturday 25 April for Anzac Day:  
L1 Dulwich Hill Line 
  • From 3am, additional L1 early-morning services between Central Grand Concourse and Dulwich Hill will run. 
  • L1 services throughout the day will run to a Saturday timetable. 
L2 Randwick Line and L3 Kingsford Line 
  • From 2.45am, additional L2 and L3 early-morning partial services between Town Hall and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford will run.
  • From first service until 6.15am, services will not run between Town Hall and Circular Quay while Anzac Day commemorations are underway in the CBD.
  • From 6.15am, full L2 and L3 services between Circular Quay and Randwick or Juniors Kingsford will resume running to a Saturday timetable.
  • Between 12.30pm and 1.30pm, L2 and L3 services may be temporarily held at stops or partially closed between Town Hall and Circular Quay, due to road closures for the Anzac Day March.
  • When L2 and L3 services are closed: use alternative transport including trains or walking. 
Allow extra travel time as services will be busy, and plan ahead at Trip Planner. Visit the Anzac Day Dawn Service & March – Sydney CBD event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD bus diversions on Anzac Day
infoLinks.content:
From 6am until 3pm on Saturday 25 April, route 343 services will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for the annual Anzac Day March.  
Buses travelling to Circular Quay will divert away from Elizabeth Street via Wentworth Avenue, College Street and Macquarie Street to end trips at The Royal Botanic Gardens, Macquarie St (2000226). 
Buses leaving Circular Quay will divert via Bridge Street, Macquarie Street, College Street and Wentworth Avenue to return to normal route on Elizabeth Street.  
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time. Visit the Anzac Day Dawn Service & March – Sydney CBD event page for more transport details. 

Missed stops: 
  • Museum Station, Downing Centre, Stand E (200049) 
  • Museum Station, Elizabeth St, Stand D (200055) 
  • St James Station, Elizabeth St, Stand C (200057) 
  • Martin Place Station, Elizabeth St, Stand C (2000421) 
  • Museum of Sydney, Phillip St (200059) 
  • Phillip St opp Museum of Sydney (200068) 
  • Martin Place Station, Elizabeth St, Stand E (2000283) 
  • Hyde Park, Elizabeth St, Stand A (2000167) 
  • Museum Station, Downing Centre, Stand A (200074) 
 
Alternative stops: 
  • Wentworth Ave after Elizabeth St (2000319) 
  • Martin Place Station, Macquarie St, Stand A (200089) 
  • The Royal Botanic Gardens, Macquarie St (2000226) 
  • The Royal Botanic Gardens, Macquarie St (200093) 
  • Sydney Hospital, Macquarie St (2000198) 
  • St Mary's Cathedral, College St (2000287)

urlText: Parramatta bus diversions for NRL match
content:
Monday 6 April
  • Road closures will be in place on sections of O’Connell St, Ross St and Victoria Rd for an NRL match at CommBank Stadium.
  • Between approximately 6pm until 6.30pm, the following bus stops will be closed and routes 546, 549, 550, 600, 601 and 606 will divert while the road closures are in place.
  • Check signs, walk to nearby alternative stops, and see the event page and road closure map for more details.
Closed and alternative stops:
  • Parramatta Leagues Club, O'Connell Street (2150150) will be closed
    – alternative stop O’Connell Street opp Harold Street (215142) for services towards the Hills and North West
  • Our Lady of Mercy College, O'Connell Street (2150152) will be closed
    – alternative stop O’Connell Street at Fennell Street (2150151) for services towards Parramatta Station
  • Victoria Road opp Prince Alfred Square (2150108) will be closed
    – alternative stop Victoria Rd opp All Saints Anglican Church (215089) for services towards Parramatta Station
  • Prince Alfred Square, Victoria Rd (2150110) will be closed
    – alternative stop All Saints' Anglican Church, Victoria Rd (215088) for services towards the Hills, Epping and Macquarie Park
subtitle: Parramatta bus diversions for NRL match

infoLinks.urlText: Changes to school bus services impacted by Waterfall Way closure
infoLinks.content:
Some school buses are not running due to the closure of Waterfall Way west of Bellingen due to a landslip.  
As an interim solution for school students in the Dorrigo and Bellingen area, a fleet of minibuses will operate school services via the detour on Summervilles Road.
From Monday 9 February, a phased approach has commenced for school bus services. Families should stay abreast of communication being distributed via their schools.
Sign up for SMS updates about interim bus service cancellations
Inclement weather and road conditions have the potential to prevent interim bus movements on the detour route and cancel services.
Transport has set up an SMS service to notify families of cancellations of services. Opt in to receive SMS via this link.

From Monday 9 February, a phased approach has commenced for school bus services. Families should stay abreast of communication being distributed via their schools.
Sign up for SMS updates about interim bus service cancellations
Inclement weather and road conditions have the potential to prevent interim bus movements on the detour route and cancel services.
Transport has set up an SMS service to notify families of cancellations of services. Opt in to receive SMS via this link.

infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Bardwell Park
infoLinks.content:
Access to Bardwell Park Station is via temporary stairs on the eastern side of Hartill-Law Avenue to enable the demolition of the existing station stairs and construction of new stairs and a lift on the western side of Hartill-Law Avenue. Allow extra time to safely cross the road at the signalised pedestrian crossing at the corner of Hartill-Law Avenue and Slade Road.

Please also note that there are no public toilets available at this station until further notice.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 18 and Sunday 19 April
  • Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction, but do not stop at Martin Place.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Cronulla, Waterfall and the City Circle, with some making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
  • Change at:
    - Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff
    - Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction.

  • From Martin Place Station, buses leave from nearby bus stops, or you can walk to Wynyard Station for trains to T4 Illawarra Line stations.
  • Metro trackwork may affect how you travel. Metro services do not run between Sydenham and Chatswood.
  • Use train services to continue your journey.
  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
20T4 Bondi Junction, Edgecliff, Kings Cross, Central and return (bypassing Martin Place)
23T4 Bondi Junction, Town Hall and return
324/325 City, Walsh Bay to Watsons Bay via Town Hall (Park St), Kings Cross, Edgecliff stations and return
333 City to Bondi Beach via Martin Place and Bondi Junction stations and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
